jobs.title: Technical Program Manager (copy)
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

As Technical Program Manager, you will lead the delivery of one of ANYbotics’ most strategically important robot platform programs, bringing engineering, operations and commercial teams together around a clear and credible path to market.

You will carry delivery accountability against the agreed specification, schedule and product-cost targets, providing one clear and credible view of the program. Working closely with Product and Engineering, you will translate agreed product and technical decisions into an executable plan across mechanical and electrical engineering, software, industrialization, supply chain, certification, quality, service and launch readiness.

This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership role. You will combine strong technical understanding with excellent program judgement, moving comfortably between detailed engineering discussions and executive-level decisions. You will bring clarity where information is incomplete, identify emerging risks and create the momentum needed to make difficult trade-offs at the right time.

You will operate as a senior individual contributor, focusing on one major program at a time and leading through influence rather than direct authority. You will work closely with functional leaders and named workstream owners, while having the opportunity to strengthen how ANYbotics runs complex product development and help shape our broader program-management capability as the company grows.

Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is pioneering autonomous robotic platforms for industrial inspection and operations in challenging environments. From explosion-proof systems in oil and gas to agile robotic platforms for power, utilities, mining, metals and other industrial settings, our technology is built for environments where safety, reliability and uptime are critical.

Our product combines advanced robotics, mechanical and electrical systems, embedded software, autonomy, inspection payloads, analytics and integrations into an end-to-end industrial solution. Bringing a new robot platform to market requires hardware and software development, industrialization, supply chain, certification, quality and customer readiness to progress together.

This creates a distinctive program-management challenge. Long hardware lead times must be balanced with iterative software development, ambitious product goals, demanding certification requirements and complex make-or-buy decisions. Strong technical program leadership is essential to turning this complexity into reliable execution.

About us

ANYbotics is a leading robotics company specialising in advanced autonomous systems. With a successful Series B financing round closed and strong momentum in the market, we are entering an important phase of growth and international expansion.

Our mission is to transform industrial inspection and operations through world-class robotics. We combine deep robotics expertise with real customer deployments in demanding industrial environments. This is an opportunity to join at a stage where the technology is proven, the ambition is high, and the decisions made now will have a major impact on the company’s future.

Your Contributions

•
 Lead an integrated robot platform program from charter through development, industrialization, launch, early-life reliability and handover, delivering against agreed specification, schedule and product-cost targets

•
 Own the integrated program plan against the agreed scope, including the baseline, milestones, dependencies, critical path, COGM targets and delivery gates

•
 Align work across hardware, software, industrialization, supply chain, certification, quality, verification and validation, service and launch readiness, maintaining one credible view of progress for senior stakeholders

•
 Work through functional leaders and named workstream owners to establish clear responsibilities, identify capability gaps and secure credible delivery commitments

•
 Identify risks and cross-functional trade-offs early, bringing forward practical options with their technical, cost and schedule implications, together with a clear recommendation

•
 Drive evidence-based program reviews and consolidated delivery readiness across quality, certification, service and launch, adapting the plan early when assumptions or technical evidence change

•
 Partner with Product and Engineering to translate agreed requirements into an executable delivery plan, including the certification and country sequencing needed to support launch

•
 Work with the CTO and Operations on make-or-buy decisions, industrialization and external-partner execution, ensuring clear interfaces, commitments and acceptance criteria

Your Profile

•
 Significant experience leading complex technical programs in robotics, autonomous systems, industrial technology, automotive, aerospace, medical devices or another advanced hardware environment

•
 Proven experience shipping a certified, volume-manufactured mechatronic product and leading it through development, industrialization and commercial launch

•
 Strong engineering foundation in mechanical, electrical, mechatronic, robotics, systems engineering or a similarly relevant discipline

•
 Technical depth to understand system architecture, challenge senior technical specialists and recognise system-level risks without needing to design every solution personally

•
 Strong command of program-planning methods, critical-path management, structured product-development processes and disciplined change control

•
 Practical experience across product cost, industrialization, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, certification and external technology or manufacturing partners

•
 Proven ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders, resolve competing viewpoints and create alignment without relying on direct authority

•
 Decisive, resilient and highly organised, with the judgement and communication skills to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment and make progress with incomplete information

Bonus Points

•
 Direct experience delivering industrial robots, autonomous machines or other complex mechatronic systems

•
 Experience with products operating in safety-critical, hazardous or highly regulated environments

•
 Experience developing a new product through platform reuse, architectural evolution or a tightly controlled derivative program

•
 Experience with international product certification, including CE, UL or comparable market-access requirements

•
 Experience transferring products from prototype or internal production into serial production with an EMS, ODM or other external manufacturing partner

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a 6-months intern to join our development A-team as of September 2026 .
 We are building the internal platform that brings computer vision models from research and prototyping into production and edge deployment on autonomous robots.

As an intern, you will work directly with the platform lead (system architect) on designing and implementing core infrastructure components. The system is defined through clear API contracts and architectural boundaries, enabling you to contribute meaningful production-grade components from day one. You will evaluate trade-offs in scalable, vendor‑neutral ML platforms, turn loosely defined research workflows into robust pipelines, and work effectively within clearly defined architectural boundaries.

This role combines hands-on engineering with exposure to real-world system design and architecture decisions.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.

Your Contributions

• Implement well-scoped platform components based on predefined API contracts

• Contribute to services for:

• dataset and artifact management (images, LiDAR, rosbags)

• model storage and execution (e.g. ONNX / TensorRT)

• evaluation and inference pipelines

• Write clean, maintainable, and testable code (primarily Python / C++ backend services)

• Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical workshops

• Help validate system behavior against defined interfaces and requirements

Your Profile

• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field

• Strong programming skills (Python preferred; backend experience is a plus)

• Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals (APIs, data structures, testing)

• Interest in machine learning systems or computer vision (prior experience is a plus, not required)

• Comfortable working in a structured environment with clearly defined interfaces

• Curious and motivated to understand why systems are designed the way they are

Bonus Points

• Experience with Docker, REST APIs, or distributed systems

• Familiarity with ML tooling (PyTorch, ONNX, TensorRT, etc.)

• Exposure to data pipelines or backend infrastructure

Interested? Submit your application

We will contact you if your skills and experience are a good fit for the team and the role. Please note due to the high load of applications we will only contact those that are relevant. Thank you for your understanding.

We are only able to consider applications from Schengen-Area citizens (or any student enrolled at ETH and EPFL who require compulsory internship). For residents outside of Switzerland, you will have to find your own accommodation in order to apply for the L or B work permit.

Internship Details:

Start date: any time of the year and always on the 1st of the month

Duration: 6 months

Workload: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

Who can apply:

EU applicants for internships

The internship can be voluntary

A work permit is not required but the candidate needs a residence permit

Must be enrolled in a University

Non-EU applicants for internships:

Internship must be mandatory (supported by a letter from a university)

A work permit is required

Must reside in CH

What We Offer:

- Hands-on experience working on advanced locomotion software.

- Mentorship from industry experts.

- Opportunities to contribute to innovative projects.

- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

- Potential for future full-time opportunities.

 Experience in AI-enabled or robotics-based product companies

This is not just a systems role — it’s a business transformation mandate. You will define and execute the PLM and MES roadmap in collaboration with executive stakeholders, ensuring alignment between engineering, operations, product, and after-sales service functions. You’ll help us build an integrated, enterprise-grade ecosystem that accelerates product development, enables traceability, and scales product data excellence.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics mechanical hardware.

Your Impact

• Product Structure & Configuration Governance

• BOM Mastery: Define and govern multi-level BOM structures for complex robotic systems, ensuring alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Service.

• Modular Architecture: Support platform-based development by managing product configurations, variants, and component reuse strategies.

• Data Standards: Enforce rigorous part-numbering schemes, revision control, and BOM rules to maintain 100% data integrity.

• PLM System Ownership & Digital Thread

• Platform Management: Own the strategic roadmap, implementation and functional administration of the PLM environment (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, CIM Database).

• System Integration: Manage the technical "Digital Thread" between CAD → PLM → ERP → MES, ensuring real-time synchronization of product and manufacturing data.

• Release Management: Oversee the lifecycle states, access controls, and workflows for all product releases and configuration baselines.

• MES & Manufacturing Data Integration

• Production Execution: Ensure the flawless transfer of product structures from PLM to the MES for production execution.

• Process Definition: Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to define production routings, assembly sequences, and digital work instructions in the MES.

• Traceability: Maintain "As-Built" traceability, ensuring consistency between MES production data and ERP production orders.

• Engineering Change (ECM) & Continuous Improvement

• Change Governance: Lead the Engineering Change Request (ECR) and Order (ECO) processes, ensuring controlled propagation of changes across all systems.

• Optimization: Drive continuous improvement in workflows to reduce NPI (New Product Introduction) cycle times and improve manufacturing scalability.

• Audit & Compliance: Conduct regular product data audits and implement corrective actions to ensure "Single Source of Truth" reliability.

Your Profile

•
7+ years of experience in Configuration, PLM and MES system management, administration and implementation, ideally in hardware or complex mechatronic product environments

Proven track record leading cross-functional PLM projects with enterprise impact — from roadmap design to hands-on delivery

Strong technical knowledge of PLM architectures (e.g., Teamcenter, Windchill, Arena, CIM Database), MES systems (e.g. Tulip, Opcenter) and their integration with ERP, CAD, and quality systems

jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced and driven Senior Electronics Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will take end-to-end technical ownership of our high-complexity Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs), directly impacting the reliability and capability of our autonomous mobile robots (ANYmal). You will bridge the gap between advanced concept designs and ruggedized, industrial-grade production, helping us scale our electronics architecture for harsh and hazardous environments.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is revolutionizing industrial inspection with ANYmal, our quadrupedal robot designed to navigate the world’s most challenging environments—from offshore oil platforms to complex chemical plants. Our technology integrates advanced robotics software with robust hardware that must withstand extreme conditions, strict EMI/EMC standards, and rigorous safety certifications. By developing highly sophisticated, reliable, and optimized electronics, you enable our robots to operate autonomously where humans cannot.

Your Impact

• Take full technical ownership and product care of 1-2 key high-complexity PCBAs (e.g., our complex communication switches or Battery Management Systems)

• Drive the PCBA development process from initial architecture and schematics through layout, prototyping, debugging, and production handover

• Strategically review and simplify our current PCBA portfolio across ANYmal product lines to optimize system architecture

• Establish rigorous test specifications and verification protocols to ensure flawless execution during productization

• Collaborate closely with systems engineers and cross-functional teams to integrate electronics seamlessly into the robot

• Champion high-quality engineering standards within the EE team, bringing strong industrial experience to the table

Your Profile

• Degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related field with at least 7 years of hands-on experience developing electronics boards for industrial, aerospace, or military applications

• Expert-level proficiency in industry-standard ECAD software (e.g., KiCad, Altium) and simulation tools like SPICE

• Proven track record of layouting your own complex designs with strict creepage, clearance, and isolation constraints for safety-critical applications

• Extensive experience designing for harsh environments, including a strong background in meeting EMI/EMC compliance and functional safety standards

• Deep expertise in debugging, verification, and defining testing specifications for manufacturing production

• Strong proficiency in at least two of the following areas: Battery Management Systems (BMS), power electronics/motor drives, high-speed interfaces (USB, EtherCAT, WiFi), or MCU-based embedded systems

• Highly accountable mindset with the ability to make firm technical decisions and own the outcomes in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points

• Experience with Explosion-proof (Ex-protection) electronics design or hazardous-area applications

• Background in wireless electronics design or Edge AI Compute Hardware

• Direct experience working within the robotics or autonomous systems industry

• Familiarity with InvenTree or similar modern tools for component and inventory management

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.

We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.

This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on Robotics Lab Technician Intern for a 6-month period to support our engineering team with hardware maintenance, troubleshooting, and lab organization. In this role, you will focus on the physical upkeep and operational readiness of our robotics systems and testing environment. This is a highly practical, execution-focused position ideal for students or technical trainees seeking direct experience with robotics hardware.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple heavy industries. Our four-legged robotic platform, ANYmal, is designed to navigate complex industrial environments autonomously, performing inspections and data collection in places that are too dangerous or difficult for humans. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology in an agile, fast-paced environment.

Your Impact

• Inspect, diagnose, and repair robotics hardware and subsystems before and after testing cycles

• Build and maintain laboratory tools, infrastructure, and test benches to ensure optimal working conditions

• Organize the laboratory space, managing component inventory, tools, and safety protocols to maintain a clean, efficient workspace

• Assist technical staff with the physical setup, wiring, and mounting of sensors and hardware testing rigs

• Execute standard test protocols on robotics systems under the guidance of our engineering team

Your Profile

• Student or trainee currently enrolled in a hands-on technical program from a university, school of applied sciences, or a relevant vocational track

• Strong practical mindset with a genuine interest in troubleshooting, repairing hardware, and working with your hands

• Methodical and organized approach to keeping a structured, tidy, and safe laboratory environment

• Basic familiarity with electronics and sensors such as multimeters, wiring, and basic test equipment

• Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, to collaborate effectively with our international technical team

Bonus Points

• Prior experience working in a makerspace, university lab, or automotive/electronics workshop

• Familiarity with Linux (Ubuntu) environment and basic command-line interfaces

• Basic soldering skills or experience with electrical crimping tools

Interested? Submit your application

We will contact you if your skills and experience are a good fit for the team and the role. Please note due to the high load of applications we will only contact those that are relevant. Thank you for your understanding.

We are only able to consider applications from Schengen-Area citizens (or any student enrolled at ETH and EPFL who require compulsory internship). For residents outside of Switzerland, you will have to find your own accommodation in order to apply for the L or B work permit.

Start date: any time of the year and always on the 1st of the month

Duration: 6 months

Workload: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

Who can apply:

EU applicants for internships

The internship can be voluntary

A work permit is not required but the candidate needs a residence permit

Must be enrolled in a University

Non-EU applicants for internships:

Internship must be mandatory (supported by a letter from a university)

A work permit is required

Must reside in CH

What We Offer:

- Hands-on experience working on advanced locomotion software.

- Mentorship from industry experts.

- Opportunities to contribute to innovative projects.

- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

- Potential for future full-time opportunities.

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive and fun environment in the city of Zurich.

• Forte mentalità pratica con un interesse reale nella risoluzione dei problemi, riparazione hardware, e lavorare con le mani

• approccio metodico e organizzato per mantenere un ambiente di laboratorio strutturato, ordinato e sicuro

• familiarità di base con l'elettronica e sensori come multimetri, cablaggio e apparecchiature di test di base

• Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese, sia scritte che parlate, per collaborare efficacemente con il nostro team tecnico internazionale

• Esperienza prioritaria che lavora in un laboratorio makerspace, nel laboratorio universitario o nel settore automobilistico/elettronico

• Familiarità con l'ambiente Linux (Ubuntu) e le interfacce di riga di comando di base

• Capacità di saldatura di base o esperienza con gli strumenti di crimpaggio elettrico

Data di inizio: in qualsiasi momento dell'anno e sempre al 1° del mese

Durata: 6 mesi

Carico di lavoro: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

Candidati UE per stage

Lo stage può essere volontario

Un permesso di lavoro non è richiesto, ma il candidato ha bisogno di un permesso di soggiorno

Deve essere iscritto a un'università

Candidati non UE per stage:

Il tirocinio deve essere obbligatorio (supportato da una lettera di un'università)

È richiesto un permesso di lavoro

Deve risiedere in CH

- Esperienza pratica che lavora sul software avanzato di locomozione.

- Mentorialità da esperti del settore.

- Opportunità di contribuire a progetti innovativi.

- Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e collaborativo.

- Potenziale per future opportunità a tempo pieno.

Vi offriamo un ambiente di lavoro molto emozionante e dinamico, l'opportunità di entrare a far parte di una società in rapida crescita e di un team ambizioso che è in missione di cambiare il mercato dell'ispezione industriale, la possibilità di sfruttare la vostra esperienza e portare le vostre idee, uno stipendio di mercato equo, un ambiente attraente e divertente nella città di Zurigo.

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

Ensuring the operational readiness of our robots by performing in-house maintenance and repairs in time is the core of this technical role. You will have a direct impact on customer success by performing diagnostics and hardware repairs on ANYmal robots and their components. You will take on full responsibilities ranging from electrical and mechanical assemblies to testing complete robots. You will collaborate with various teams and contribute to the improvement of our maintenance and manufacturing processes. We are looking for an independent and motivated Robotics Technician (Polymechanic / Electronics or Automation Technician) to join our team, which focuses on maintaining customer robots as well as our internal fleet, and supporting the prototype and series production of new robots at our production site in the city of Zurich.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms the industrial sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach (see our case studies in Chemicals , Oil & Gas , Railways , Wind Energy , Mining , Construction ). Our customers are large asset operators and service providers of industrial plants pioneering robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our solution enables autonomous routine inspections and monitoring of large-scale industrial facilities for increased safety and productivity. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and software to achieve world-class mobility, autonomy, and inspection capabilities, often based on AI. We have proven the technology and the business impact on our customers in long-term pilot projects. We are now scaling the commercialization of our solution(s) and deploying directly into operation at customer facilities worldwide.

Your Contributions

• Maintenance, diagnostic and repair of customer robots and our internal fleet

• Troubleshooting electromechanical products and prototypes to identify and fix technical issues

• Conducting tests and quality control of components and robots, including commissioning

• Manufacturing and assembly of modules and robots for prototypes and 0-Series production

• Documenting non-conformances and contributing to corrective and preventive actions

• Contributing to the further development of our manufacturing, assembly, and test procedures

• Supporting the continuous improvement of the technical equipment and infrastructure

Your Profile

• Apprenticeship as a Polymechanic or Automation Technician EFZ

• 3 years + work experience in the field of mechatronics or equipment manufacturing

• Good practical knowledge in the assembly of electromechanical components

• Understanding of technical drawings and work instructions

• Experience with measuring tools, testing equipment and ESD standards

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Good general computer skills (preferably Google Workspace)

• Very good German and English skills (Level B2)

Bonus Points

• Experience in production, repair and troubleshooting of electronic assemblies

• Driving license CH-Cat. B

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

• Help build migration-ready datasets and folder/document structures that will be reused for future PLM implementation and vendor evaluation

• Create lightweight user support materials, including simple work instructions, screenshots, and known-issue logs for engineering, quality, and certification teams

Your Profile

• Structured and detail-oriented working style with a high comfort level handling engineering documents, metadata, lists, and folder structures

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

As a Field Engineer at ANYbotics, you will lead the customer adoption journey. You will own the strategic execution of multi-site projects, ensuring our solutions are not only successfully deployed but deeply integrated into our customers' workflows. • Lead Deployment Projects: Lead complex, multi-site customer projects from onboarding through to operational autonomy. Ensure smooth deployments, manage timelines and value delivery.

• Stakeholder & Change Management: Act as the primary point of contact for customer leadership and operations teams. Drive user adoption by navigating organizational dynamics, identifying resistance, and championing the value of robotics within their operational culture.

• Strategic Feedback Loop: Translate field insights and recurring operational themes into actionable requirements for our Product and R&D teams, ensuring the voice of the customer drives our innovation.

Your Profile

• Education: Degree in engineering, robotics or a related field

• Experience: Proven track record in customer-facing role, ideally within robotics, industrial automation, or complex technical systems.

• Communication: Excellent communicator, comfortable presenting to both executive leadership and operational teams. Ability to simplify complex technical concepts into clear, business-focused outcomes.

• Change Management: Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder relationships, navigate organizational dynamics, and drive user adoption in industrial environments.

• Operational Leadership: Strong capability to coordinate teams, manage on-site priorities, and maintain project continuity in high-pressure, international settings.

• Travel: Enthusiastic about frequent international travel (up to 60%) and comfortable working directly in customer environments.

• Mindset: Collaborative, empathetic, and relentlessly focused on the customer's path to success

Bonus Points

• Experience with deploying robots or other automation systems

• Experience with Linux and command-line usage

• Familiarity with network infrastructure

• Proficiency in German or other languages (French, Spanish, Portuguese, etc.)

• Strategic Feedback Loop: Tradurre intuizioni sul campo e ricorrenti temi operativi in requisiti attuabili per i nostri team di prodotto e R&D, garantendo la voce del cliente guida la nostra innovazione.

Il tuo profilo

• Istruzione: Laurea in ingegneria, robotica o un campo correlato

• Esperienza: Provato record di traccia nel ruolo di customer-facing, idealmente all'interno di robotica, automazione industriale, o sistemi tecnici complessi.

• Comunicazione: Eccellente comunicatore, confortevole presentando sia la leadership esecutiva che le squadre operative. Capacità di semplificare i concetti tecnici complessi in risultati chiari e focalizzati sul business.

• Gestione dei cambiamenti: capacità dimostrata di gestire le relazioni degli stakeholder, navigare in dinamiche organizzative e guidare l'adozione degli utenti in ambienti industriali.

• Leadership operativa: forte capacità di coordinare i team, gestire le priorità in loco e mantenere la continuità del progetto in ambienti internazionali ad alta pressione.

• Viaggi: Enthusiastic su frequenti viaggi internazionali (fino al 60%) e comodo lavoro direttamente negli ambienti dei clienti.

• Mindset: collaborativo, empatico, e senza sosta focalizzato sul percorso del cliente al successo

Punti bonus

• Esperienza con l'implementazione di robot o altri sistemi di automazione

• Esperienza con Linux e utilizzo della riga di comando

• Familiarità con le infrastrutture di rete

• Competenza in tedesco o in altre lingue (francese, spagnolo, portoghese, ecc.)

Unisciti a noi nella costruzione di un team inclusivo e diversificato dove le tue competenze e le tue esperienze uniche saranno apprezzate e apprezzate come Costruiamo il Futuro della Robotica!

Siamo una società di robotica internazionale con la A-team diffusa in tutto il mondo. Questo ruolo ti dà l'opportunità di partecipare alla crescita della nostra presenza nell'UE, rimanendo in contatto con il nostro team globale. Per essere idonei, avrete bisogno di avere il diritto legale di vivere e lavorare in Spagna. Idealmente si risiede a Barcellona, o sono aperti a trasferirsi. Questa non è una posizione remota

Politica dell'Agenzia: Attualmente non stiamo collaborando con aziende di ricerca esterne o agenzie di reclutamento. Anybotics est une société technologique en croissance rapide dédiée à façonner l'avenir de la robotique mobile dans plusieurs industries. Rejoignez notre équipe hautement talentueuse et motivée de plus de 200 personnes et travaillez sur la technologie robot de pointe.

L'opportunité

En tant qu'ingénieur de terrain chez Anybotics, vous dirigerez le parcours d'adoption client. Vous posséderez l'exécution stratégique de projets multi-sites, garantissant que nos solutions sont non seulement déployées avec succès mais profondément intégrées dans les flux de travail de nos clients. Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact où vous représenterez tout le monde sur le terrain, mettre en œuvre la solution robotique, faciliter la gestion du changement et aligner le succès client sur nos objectifs opérationnels. Vous agirez comme conseiller de confiance pour les intervenants, gérerez les échéanciers des projets, orchestrez les déploiements et assurez-vous que notre technologie offre une valeur mesurable et un impact opérationnel.

En rejoignant notre équipe, vous développerez continuellement vos compétences en robotique, en opérations sur le terrain et en gestion du succès client. Chaque projet présente des défis distincts qui exigent une adaptabilité, une curiosité et une passion pour résoudre des problèmes. Vos idées et expériences sur le terrain façonneront directement l'avenir de notre technologie, en collaborant avec nos équipes de recherche et développement pour améliorer et affiner nos offres.

Anybotics s'engage à construire une équipe diversifiée et inclusive où tout le monde apprécie sa perspective. Nous accueillons tous les candidats qui sont impatients de faire progresser la robotique et d'avoir un impact tangible. En vous joignant à nous, vous trouverez un environnement de soutien qui favorise la croissance professionnelle et vous encourage à apporter votre plein et authentique moi à l'équipe.

Le marché et notre technologie

Anybotics transforme les environnements industriels dans les secteurs de l'énergie, des procédés et des services publics en introduisant la robotique dans des applications jusque-là hors de portée. Notre robot mobile, Anymal, utilise des jambes pour une mobilité extrême dans des environnements complexes, la détection à base de caméra et de LIDAR pour une pleine autonomie, et l'IA pour des résultats d'inspection de haute qualité. Avec des logiciels presque entièrement développés à l'interne, Anymal effectue des missions d'inspection autonomes pour les grands opérateurs d'actifs et les fournisseurs de services industriels pionniers en robotique pour l'inspection et l'entretien.

Vos contributions

• Projets de déploiement principal : Diriger des projets clients complexes et multisites, depuis l'embarquement jusqu'à l'autonomie opérationnelle. Assurer des déploiements en douceur, gérer les délais et la valeur de livraison.

• Gestion des intervenants et du changement : agir comme principal point de contact pour le leadership des clients et les équipes opérationnelles. Favoriser l'adoption par les utilisateurs en naviguant sur la dynamique organisationnelle, en identifiant la résistance et en défendant la valeur de la robotique dans leur culture opérationnelle.

• Leadership des opérations sur le terrain : Coordonner le travail opérationnel des techniciens de terrain et des spécialistes internes. Établir des priorités, allouer des ressources et résoudre les obstacles sur place pour maintenir l'élan et la qualité du projet.

• Avis de confiance : Consultez les clients industriels mondiaux pour intégrer la robotique à leurs flux de travail plus larges. Faire le pont entre leurs défis opérationnels et nos équipes techniques, en veillant à ce que notre feuille de route corresponde à leurs besoins.

• Réalisation de valeur et formation : Dirigez des séances de formation et de facilitation pour divers publics, des opérateurs sur le terrain à la gestion des installations, en adaptant votre approche pour maximiser la confiance des utilisateurs et l'utilisation du système.

• Loop de rétroaction stratégique: Traduisez des informations sur le terrain et des thèmes opérationnels récurrents en exigences réalisables pour nos équipes Produit et R-D, en assurant la voix du client conduit notre innovation.

Votre profil

• Études : Diplôme en génie, robotique ou domaine connexe

• Expérience : Expérience éprouvée dans le rôle du client, idéalement dans la robotique, l'automatisation industrielle ou des systèmes techniques complexes.

• Communication : Excellent communicateur, à l'aise avec les équipes de direction et opérationnelles. Capacité de simplifier les concepts techniques complexes en des résultats clairs et axés sur l'entreprise.

• Gestion du changement : Capacité démontrée de gérer les relations avec les intervenants, de naviguer dans la dynamique organisationnelle et de favoriser l'adoption des utilisateurs dans les environnements industriels.

• Leadership opérationnel : Forte capacité de coordonner les équipes, de gérer les priorités sur place et de maintenir la continuité des projets dans des contextes internationaux à haute pression.

• Voyage: Enthousiaste sur les voyages internationaux fréquents (jusqu'à 60%) et confortable travaillant directement dans les environnements clients.

• Mindset: Collaboration, empathie, et sans relâche axé sur la voie du succès du client

Points bonus

• Expérience du déploiement de robots ou d'autres systèmes d'automatisation

• Expérience avec Linux et utilisation en ligne de commande

• Familiarité avec l'infrastructure réseau

• Maîtrise de l'allemand ou d'autres langues (français, espagnol, portugais, etc.)

Rejoignez-nous dans la construction d'une équipe inclusive et diversifiée où vos compétences et expériences uniques seront valorisées et appréciées alors que nous construisons l'avenir de la robotique!

Nous sommes une entreprise internationale de robotique avec l'équipe A répandue dans le Globe. Ce rôle vous donne l'occasion de participer à l'accroissement de notre présence dans l'UE tout en restant connecté à notre équipe mondiale. Pour être éligible, vous devrez avoir le droit légal de vivre et de travailler en Espagne. Idéalement, vous résidez à Barcelone, ou êtes ouvert à la réinstallation. Ce n'est pas une position distante

Politique de l'Agence : Nous ne sommes pas en partenariat avec des entreprises de recherche externes ou des agences de recrutement. Tous les profils ou curriculum vitae soumis à des employés d'Anybotics sans accord écrit préalable seront considérés comme une divulgation publique et la propriété d'Anybotics, ce qui n'implique aucune responsabilité ni aucun droit pour l'embauche ultérieure.
